<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 182.073, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da.  

The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 14 % of the base peak and a small M+2 peak) is characteristic of a molecule containing about 13 carbon atoms (each ¹³C contributes ~1.1 % to the M+1 envelope).  

A formula that matches the exact mass and the isotopic pattern is **C₁₃H₉O** (neutral mass 181.0653 Da, error ≈ 3 ppm). No other heteroatoms are required to explain the observed pattern.  

Thus the molecular formula of the compound in the sample is:  

**C13H9O**  

</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O</final_answer>
